scope.summary: Implement sparse morph delta storage and application with multi-key tracks per Section 13.17 (BK-17.2, TAI-BK-033), closing REQ-009: every tissue channel is a sequence of sculpted keys at 0/50/100/200/300% of design nominal (key_pct on bodykit_morph_assets), piecewise-interpolated at evaluation time — scaling a single delta linearly past its sculpted value is PROHIBITED as an evaluation strategy.
acceptance_criteria: SparseDeltas stores (vertex_id, dx, dy, dz in mm) pairs sorted by vertex_id; apply is O(deltas) and never touches vertices absent from the set.

MorphTrack holds sculpted keys at key_pct positions (0/50/100/200/300 canonical; fewer keys allowed when useful range ends at 100 per TAI-BK-033) and evaluates a channel value by piecewise interpolation between the two bracketing sculpted keys.
Evaluating at a value beyond the last sculpted key returns a typed error (no extrapolation path exists in the code).
A regression test proves interpolated evaluation at 250% differs from naive 2.5x scaling of the 100% delta on a fixture track (the anti-linear-degeneration property).
Track payloads load from bodykit_morph_assets refs and validate their region_mask_ref matches the owning channel's mask.
scope.risk_if_missed: Single-delta linear scaling at extremes is Daz's biggest visible failure — breast spikes and crease collapse past 100% — and the operator's extreme-volume archetypes live precisely in the 100-300% band multi-key tracks exist to make sculpt-quality.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
